target_text: Regional partners coordinated through the Changi RHCC [Changi Regional HADR Coordination Centre] when multiple offers of support arrived at once.

source_text: Kerajaan terjejas meminta sokongan angkat berat daripada US INDOPACOM [United States Indo-Pacific Command] untuk komuniti gunung yang terpencil.
target_text: The affected government requested heavy-lift support from US INDOPACOM [United States Indo-Pacific Command] for isolated mountain communities.

source_text: Nota perhubungan daripada PLA [People's Liberation Army] menjelaskan bagaimana tawaran rakan perlu disusun sebelum sokongan rakan bergerak ke komun utara.
target_text: A liaison note from PLA [People's Liberation Army] clarified how partner offers should be sequenced before partner support moved toward the northern communes.

source_text: Kemas kini situasi daripada AHA Centre [ASEAN Coordinating Centre for Humanitarian Assistance on disaster management] membantu menyelaraskan keutamaan bantuan merentas rakan ASEAN.
target_text: Situation updates from the AHA Centre [ASEAN Coordinating Centre for Humanitarian Assistance on disaster management] helped align relief priorities across ASEAN partners.

source_text: Kementerian kerajaan dan agensi kemanusiaan menyertai panggilan koordinasi yang dihoskan oleh UN OCHA [United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs].
target_text: Government ministries and humanitarian agencies joined the coordination call hosted by UN OCHA [United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs].

source_text: Di daerah yang rosak, ASEAN-ERAT [ASEAN Emergency Response and Assessment Team] mengesahkan keperluan tempat perlindungan sebelum bekalan tambahan dihantar.
target_text: In the damaged district, ASEAN-ERAT [ASEAN Emergency Response and Assessment Team] verified shelter needs before additional supplies were dispatched.

source_text: Papan tugasan merekodkan ACMC [Australian Civil-Military Centre] sebagai hubungan koordinasi utama bagi sokongan tempat perlindungan di koridor jalan gunung.
target_text: The tasking board recorded ACMC [Australian Civil-Military Centre] as the key coordination contact for shelter support in the mountain road corridor.

source_text: Pegawai daerah mengaitkan ToR [Terms of Reference] dengan jendela pengagihan yang disemak semula selepas laporan dari perkampungan pulau sungai berubah semalaman.
target_text: district officers linked ToR [Terms of Reference] to a revised distribution window after reports from river-island hamlets changed overnight.

source_text: Kluster kesihatan meminta WHO [World Health Organization] menyemak pelan pengawasan penyakit.
target_text: The health cluster asked WHO [World Health Organization] to review the disease surveillance plan.

source_text: Pihak berkuasa tempatan berkoordinasi dengan WFP [World Food Programme] untuk menghantar pakej makanan ke pusat pemindahan.
target_text: Local authorities coordinated with WFP [World Food Programme] to deliver food packages to evacuation centres.

source_text: Kerani logistik menggunakan ToR [Terms of Reference] apabila serpihan tidak selamat berhampiran gudang menjadikan perancangan bagi kawasan gudang wilayah kurang dapat diramal.
target_text: logistics clerks applied ToR [Terms of Reference] when unsafe debris near a warehouse made planning for the provincial warehouse area less predictable.

source_text: Geran tempat perlindungan kecemasan disemak oleh USAID BHA [United States Agency for International Development, Bureau for Humanitarian Assistance] semasa mesyuarat koordinasi penderma.
target_text: Emergency shelter grants were reviewed by USAID BHA [United States Agency for International Development, Bureau for Humanitarian Assistance] during the donor coordination meeting.

source_text: Pegawai pertahanan serantau membincangkan kesiapsiagaan HADR di bawah rangka kerja ADMM-Plus [ASEAN Defence Ministers' Meeting Plus].
target_text: Regional defence officials discussed HADR readiness under the ADMM-Plus [ASEAN Defence Ministers' Meeting Plus] framework.

source_text: Pengajaran daripada EWG on HADR [Experts' Working Group on Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief] ditambah ke dalam matriks penilaian latihan.
target_text: Lessons from the EWG on HADR [Experts' Working Group on Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief] were added to the exercise evaluation matrix.

source_text: Ketua pasukan penyelamat menyemak panduan INSARAG [International Search and Rescue Advisory Group] sebelum menetapkan sektor carian.
target_text: The rescue team leader checked INSARAG [International Search and Rescue Advisory Group] guidance before assigning search sectors.

source_text: Nota mesyuarat disalurkan melalui ASEAN Secretariat [Central administrative body for ASEAN] untuk pengedaran rasmi.
target_text: Meeting notes were routed through the ASEAN Secretariat [Central administrative body for ASEAN] for official distribution.

source_text: Unit perubatan dan kejuruteraan yang boleh dikerahkan dikatalogkan oleh AMRG on HADR [ASEAN Militaries Ready Group on HADR].
target_text: Deployable medical and engineering units were catalogued by the AMRG on HADR [ASEAN Militaries Ready Group on HADR].

source_text: Negara tuan rumah meminta sokongan penulenan air daripada SAF [Singapore Armed Forces] selepas telaga tercemar.
target_text: The host nation requested water purification support from SAF [Singapore Armed Forces] after wells were contaminated.

source_text: Peralatan kejuruteraan daripada PLA [People's Liberation Army] ditugaskan untuk memulihkan akses ke lintasan sungai.
target_text: Engineering equipment from the PLA [People's Liberation Army] was assigned to restore access to the river crossing.

source_text: Tugasan serantau harian diselaraskan melalui JOCCA [Joint Operations and Coordination Centre of ASEAN] semasa tempoh puncak tindak balas.
target_text: Daily regional tasking was coordinated through JOCCA [Joint Operations and Coordination Centre of ASEAN] during the peak response period.

source_text: Prosedur carian struktur runtuh ditunjukkan oleh SCDF [Singapore Civil Defence Force] semasa latihan lapangan.
target_text: Collapsed-structure search procedures were demonstrated by SCDF [Singapore Civil Defence Force] during the field drill.

source_text: Pos arahan nasional melaporkan semua tawaran antarabangsa kepada VINASARCOM [Vietnam's National Steering Committee for Civil Defense].
target_text: The national command post reported all international offers to VINASARCOM [Vietnam's National Steering Committee for Civil Defense].

source_text: Keutamaan pertahanan banjir daripada VDDMA [Vietnam Disaster and Dyke Management Authority] membentuk peruntukan pam dan beg pasir.
target_text: Flood defence priorities from VDDMA [Vietnam Disaster and Dyke Management Authority] shaped the allocation of pumps and sandbags.

source_text: Sokongan pembaikan jambatan disediakan oleh jurutera VPA [Vietnam People's Army] selepas laluan bekalan utama gagal.
target_text: Bridge repair support was provided by VPA [Vietnam People's Army] engineers after the main supply route failed.

source_text: Data kerugian pertanian daripada MARD [Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development] memaklumkan perancangan pemulihan awal.
target_text: Agricultural loss data from MARD [Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development] informed early recovery planning.

source_text: Kemas kini pembersihan jalan daripada MOT [Ministry of Transport] ditambah ke dalam gambaran operasi bersama.
target_text: Road clearance updates from MOT [Ministry of Transport] were added to the common operating picture.

source_text: Keutamaan pemindahan perubatan diluluskan oleh MOH [Ministry of Health] sebelum helikopter dilancarkan.
target_text: Medical evacuation priorities were approved by MOH [Ministry of Health] before helicopters launched.

source_text: Rakan pemulihan di bawah DRRP [Vietnam Disaster Risk Reduction Partnership] mengenal pasti komuniti keutamaan untuk program ketahanan.
target_text: Recovery partners under DRRP [Vietnam Disaster Risk Reduction Partnership] identified priority communes for resilience programming.

source_text: Mesej kesiapsiagaan yang disokong oleh QPT [Community Fund for Natural Disaster Prevention] sampai kepada isi rumah di kawasan mudah tanah runtuh.
target_text: Preparedness messaging supported by QPT [Community Fund for Natural Disaster Prevention] reached households in landslide-prone areas.

source_text: Pasukan pertolongan cemas daripada VNRC [Vietnam Red Cross] membantu warga emas yang dipindahkan di tempat perlindungan sekolah.
target_text: First aid teams from VNRC [Vietnam Red Cross] assisted elderly evacuees at the school shelter.

source_text: Laporan kesiapsiagaan hospital daripada VAMS [Vietnam Administration of Medical Service] dikongsi semasa taklimat kesihatan petang.
target_text: Hospital readiness reports from VAMS [Vietnam Administration of Medical Service] were shared during the evening health briefing.

source_text: Serah tugas operasi menggunakan format WoG [Whole-of-Government] untuk menggabungkan kemas kini daerah pesisir daripada pegawai pengangkutan, kesihatan dan pertahanan.
target_text: The operational handover used a WoG [Whole-of-Government] format to combine coastal district updates from transport, health, and defence officials.

source_text: Rakan antarabangsa menunggu NDMO [National Disaster Management Office] mengesahkan senarai keperluan rasmi.
target_text: International partners waited for the NDMO [National Disaster Management Office] to confirm the official needs list.

source_text: Apabila kemas kini daripada ibu negeri wilayah bercanggah, CMCoord [Civil-Military Coordination] memberi perancang cara yang lebih jelas untuk membandingkan keutamaan.
target_text: When updates from the provincial capital conflicted, CMCoord [Civil-Military Coordination] gave planners a clearer way to compare priorities.

source_text: Perancang menyemak Mil-Mil [Military-to-Military coordination] sebelum menetapkan tanggungjawab pengagihan bantuan semasa kitaran koordinasi pagi.
target_text: Planners reviewed Mil-Mil [Military-to-Military coordination] before assigning responsibility for relief distribution during the morning coordination cycle.

source_text: Pasukan tindak balas menyemak Civ-Mil [Civilian-Military coordination] selepas pengulang radio yang rosak mendedahkan kelemahan dalam perancangan untuk tapak jambatan sementara.
target_text: The response team reviewed Civ-Mil [Civilian-Military coordination] after a damaged radio repeater exposed a weakness in planning for the temporary bridge site.

source_text: Apabila pasukan kesihatan awam melaporkan air pasang berhampiran muara sungai, AS [Negara Terjejas] menjadi titik rujukan untuk kawasan carian yang lebih sempit.
target_text: When public health teams reported high tide near the river mouth, AS [Affected State] became the reference point for a narrower search area.

source_text: MNCC [Multi-National Coordination Centre] menyediakan konteks yang hilang selepas ketua penilaian mempersoalkan laporan daripada jalan pintas bukit.
target_text: MNCC [Multi-National Coordination Centre] provided the missing context after assessment leads questioned reports from the hill road bypass.

source_text: Laporan daerah sampai ke EOC [Emergency Operations Centre] sebelum taklimat nasional bermula.
target_text: District reports reached the EOC [Emergency Operations Centre] before the national briefing began.

source_text: Wilayah itu menyerahkan RFA [Request for Assistance] untuk unit rawatan air dan pasukan perubatan bergerak.
target_text: The province submitted an RFA [Request for Assistance] for water treatment units and mobile medical teams.

source_text: Angka penghunian tempat perlindungan ditambah ke COP [Common Operating Picture] sebelum kemas kini komander.
target_text: Shelter occupancy figures were added to the COP [Common Operating Picture] before the commanders' update.

source_text: Pasukan menyemak semula SAR [Search and Rescue] kerana kekurangan kru ambulans menjejaskan cara wakil penderma merancang kemas kini komander yang lebih ringkas.
target_text: The team revisited SAR [Search and Rescue] because a shortage of ambulance crews affected how donor representatives planned a shorter commander update.

source_text: Blok pangsapuri runtuh memerlukan anjing USAR [Urban Search and Rescue] tambahan dan peralatan carian teknikal.
target_text: The collapsed apartment block required additional USAR [Urban Search and Rescue] dogs and technical search equipment.

source_text: Pasukan tindak balas menyemak AS [Negara Terjejas] selepas pengulang radio yang rosak mendedahkan kelemahan dalam perancangan untuk jalur pemindahan utara.
target_text: The response team reviewed AS [Affected State] after a damaged radio repeater exposed a weakness in planning for the northern evacuation belt.

source_text: Sebelum pembersihan serpihan bermula, responden memeriksa sama ada bahaya CBRE [Chemical, Biological, Radiological, and Explosive impact] wujud.
target_text: Before debris clearance began, responders checked whether CBRE [Chemical, Biological, Radiological, and Explosive impact] hazards were present.

source_text: Apabila gelongsoran lumpur di atas jalan pintas muncul, PLA [People's Liberation Army] bekerjasama dengan penyelia penyelamat mengenai pasukan penilaian yang lebih kecil di pekan pasar rendah.
target_text: When mudslides above the bypass emerged, PLA [People's Liberation Army] worked with rescue supervisors on a smaller assessment team in a low-lying market town.

source_text: Tandas kecemasan dan titik air bersih dikelompokkan di bawah WASH [Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene] dalam pelan sektor.
target_text: Emergency latrines and clean water points were grouped under WASH [Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene] in the sector plan.

source_text: Selimut, tikar tidur dan set dapur direkodkan sebagai stok NFI [Non-Food Items].
target_text: Blankets, sleeping mats, and kitchen sets were recorded as NFI [Non-Food Items] stocks.

source_text: HOC [Humanitarian Operations Centre] menyumbang kemas kini berfokus mengenai kerosakan jambatan, yang membantu pasukan melaras keutamaan bagi pangkalan pementasan sementara.
target_text: HOC [Humanitarian Operations Centre] contributed a focused update on bridge damage, which helped the team adjust priorities for the temporary staging base.

source_text: Pengurus gudang melaporkan kekurangan bahan api dan lori kepada LCC [Logistics Coordination Centre].
target_text: Warehouse managers reported fuel and truck shortages to the LCC [Logistics Coordination Centre].

source_text: Pasukan menyemak semula COP [Common Operating Picture] kerana pembetung tersumbat berhampiran MSR menjejaskan cara pengurus gudang merancang nota keutamaan sektor yang seimbang.
target_text: The team revisited COP [Common Operating Picture] because a blocked culvert near the MSR affected how warehouse managers planned a balanced sector priority note.

source_text: Latihan hospital meningkat menjadi senario MASCAS [Mass Casualty Incident] dengan pesakit trauma simulasi.
target_text: The hospital drill escalated into a MASCAS [Mass Casualty Incident] scenario with simulated trauma patients.

source_text: Pasukan penyelamat yang tiba mendapat manfaat daripada Mutual Recognition [Certification agreement for USAR teams] semasa proses pengerahan.
target_text: Incoming rescue teams benefited from Mutual Recognition [Certification agreement for USAR teams] during the deployment process.

source_text: Kargo bantuan bergerak melalui APOD [Aerial Port of Disembarkation] sebelum dibawa dengan lori ke pedalaman.
target_text: Relief cargo moved through the APOD [Aerial Port of Disembarkation] before being trucked inland.

source_text: Pasukan logistik mengalihkan peralatan berat melalui SPOD [Sea Port of Disembarkation] untuk mengurangkan kesesakan lapangan terbang.
target_text: The logistics team shifted heavy equipment through the SPOD [Sea Port of Disembarkation] to reduce airfield congestion.

source_text: Jurutera membuka semula MSR [Main Supply Route] yang menghubungkan gudang wilayah dengan kawasan pemindahan.
target_text: Engineers reopened the MSR [Main Supply Route] linking the provincial warehouse to the evacuation area.

source_text: Responden yang tiba melengkapkan pemeriksaan CIQ [Customs, Immigration, and Quarantine] sebelum bergerak ke pangkalan pementasan.
target_text: Incoming responders completed CIQ [Customs, Immigration, and Quarantine] checks before moving to the staging base.

source_text: Kerajaan menerima sokongan MCDA [Military and Civil Defence Assets] untuk pengangkutan, kejuruteraan dan pemindahan perubatan.
target_text: The government accepted MCDA [Military and Civil Defence Assets] support for transport, engineering, and medical evacuation.

source_text: Keutamaan kemanusiaan dilindungi dengan menggunakan HuMOCC [Humanitarian-Military Operational Coordination Concept] sebagai rujukan koordinasi.
target_text: Humanitarian priorities were protected by using HuMOCC [Humanitarian-Military Operational Coordination Concept] as the coordination reference.

source_text: Polis, pakar forensik dan staf kesihatan membentuk kumpulan koordinasi DVI [Disaster Victim Identification].
target_text: Police, forensic specialists, and health staff formed the DVI [Disaster Victim Identification] coordination group.

source_text: Pemimpin kampung memaklumkan LEMA [Local Emergency Management Authority] bahawa satu tempat perlindungan telah kehabisan air minuman.
target_text: Village leaders informed LEMA [Local Emergency Management Authority] that one shelter had run out of drinking water.

source_text: Peserta dalam Ex COORES [Exercise Coordinated Response] berlatih membuat keputusan di bawah senario bencana serantau yang realistik.
target_text: Participants in Ex COORES [Exercise Coordinated Response] practiced decision-making under a realistic regional disaster scenario.

source_text: Pegawai perhubungan menggunakan TTX [Table-Top Exercise] apabila had berat jalan yang tidak pasti menjadikan perancangan bagi kawasan gudang wilayah kurang dapat diramal.
target_text: liaison officers applied TTX [Table-Top Exercise] when uncertain road weight limits made planning for the provincial warehouse area less predictable.

source_text: Pasukan tindak balas menyemak OPERA CIS [Computer Information System for information sharing] selepas kelompok kes demam mendedahkan kelemahan dalam perancangan untuk lintasan feri yang rosak.
target_text: The response team reviewed OPERA CIS [Computer Information System for information sharing] after a cluster of fever cases exposed a weakness in planning for the damaged ferry crossing.

source_text: Pegawai menyemak SASOP [Standard Operating Procedures for Regional Standby Arrangements] sebelum meminta aset siap siaga serantau.
target_text: Officials checked SASOP [Standard Operating Procedures for Regional Standby Arrangements] before requesting regional standby assets.

source_text: Pengerahan aset tentera disemak berdasarkan SASOP Chapter VI [Section governing facilitation and utilization of military assets] semasa senario tersebut.
target_text: Military asset deployment was reviewed against SASOP Chapter VI [Section governing facilitation and utilization of military assets] during the scenario.

source_text: Penasihat undang-undang memetik AADMER [ASEAN Agreement on Disaster Management and Emergency Response] ketika menjelaskan mekanisme tindak balas bencana ASEAN.
target_text: The legal advisor cited AADMER [ASEAN Agreement on Disaster Management and Emergency Response] when explaining ASEAN disaster response mechanisms.

source_text: Pasukan reka bentuk senario menyesuaikan injek ARDEX [ASEAN Regional Disaster Emergency Response Simulation Exercise] untuk latihan tindak balas banjir.
target_text: The scenario design team adapted an ARDEX [ASEAN Regional Disaster Emergency Response Simulation Exercise] inject for the flood response exercise.

source_text: SME [Subject Matter Expert] logistik memberi amaran bahawa pelabuhan boleh menjadi kesesakan dalam beberapa jam.
target_text: The logistics SME [Subject Matter Expert] warned that the port could become a bottleneck within hours.

source_text: Semasa AAR [After Action Review], peserta menyatakan bahawa pegawai perhubungan memerlukan nota serah tugas yang lebih jelas.
target_text: During the AAR [After Action Review], participants noted that liaison officers needed clearer handover notes.

source_text: Laporan yang dirangka dengan GenAI [Generative AI] masih memerlukan semakan oleh staf operasi manusia.
target_text: Reports drafted with GenAI [Generative AI] still required review by human operational staff.

source_text: Kemas kini petang memasukkan PLA [People's Liberation Army] kerana maklum balas komuniti menjejaskan perancangan tempatan dan koordinasi serantau.
target_text: The evening update included PLA [People's Liberation Army] because community feedback affected both local planning and regional coordination.

source_text: Peta banjir yang diperoleh daripada Sentinel-1 [Satellite imaging program] membantu mengesahkan jalan mana yang masih boleh dilalui.
target_text: Flood maps derived from Sentinel-1 [Satellite imaging program] helped confirm which roads were still passable.

source_text: Garis masa tindak balas dilaraskan sekitar Copernicus [Satellite imaging program] apabila kerosakan jambatan menjejaskan komuniti di kampung hilir.
target_text: The response timeline was adjusted around Copernicus [Satellite imaging program] once bridge damage affected communities in the downstream villages.

source_text: Pasukan tindak balas menyemak Digital Twin [Proposed virtual replica project for simulation accuracy] selepas senarai penerima yang hilang mendedahkan kelemahan dalam perancangan untuk titik perhimpunan komun terpencil.
target_text: The response team reviewed Digital Twin [Proposed virtual replica project for simulation accuracy] after a missing beneficiary list exposed a weakness in planning for the remote commune assembly point.

source_text: Taklimat koordinasi memetik input daripada MOT [Ministry of Transport] selepas gangguan telekomunikasi mengubah andaian tindak balas.
target_text: The coordination brief cited inputs from MOT [Ministry of Transport] after telecommunications outages changed the response assumptions.

source_text: Sel perancangan menggunakan Interoperability [Ability of different systems to exchange data] untuk memutuskan sama ada kampung nelayan pesisir memerlukan taklimat keputusan yang lebih ringkas.
target_text: The planning cell used Interoperability [Ability of different systems to exchange data] to decide whether coastal fishing villages needed a simpler decision brief.

source_text: Bagi koridor tanah runtuh tanah tinggi, Information Overload [Challenge of managing high data volumes during peak impact] memberi pasukan cara untuk membandingkan kekurangan kru ambulans dengan risiko tindak balas lain.
target_text: For the upland landslide corridor, Information Overload [Challenge of managing high data volumes during peak impact] gave the team a way to compare a shortage of ambulance crews with other response risks.

source_text: Sel koordinasi mengemas kini ToR [Terms of Reference] selepas pegawai perhubungan baharu tiba.
target_text: The coordination cell updated its ToR [Terms of Reference] after new liaison officers arrived.

source_text: Komander memberi taklimat CONOPS [Concept of Operations] sebelum menugaskan tugas kepada unit rakan.
target_text: The commander briefed the CONOPS [Concept of Operations] before assigning tasks to partner units.

source_text: Setiap tawaran bantuan disalurkan melalui NFP [National Focal Point] sebelum penerimaan.
target_text: Every offer of assistance was routed through the NFP [National Focal Point] before acceptance.

source_text: Pegawai perhubungan menggunakan HADR [Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief] apabila kelompok kes demam menjadikan perancangan untuk kawasan tadahan hospital timur kurang dapat diramal.
target_text: liaison officers applied HADR [Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief] when a cluster of fever cases made planning for the eastern hospital catchment less predictable.

source_text: Pegawai daerah berunding dengan Changi RHCC [Changi Regional HADR Coordination Centre] ketika menyelaraskan laporan tempat perlindungan dengan kekangan akses di kawasan pelabuhan yang rosak.
target_text: District officials consulted Changi RHCC [Changi Regional HADR Coordination Centre] while reconciling shelter reports with access constraints in the damaged port area.

source_text: Sebelum meluluskan pakej sokongan seterusnya, perancang meminta US INDOPACOM [United States Indo-Pacific Command] mengesahkan di mana masa pengagihan perlu dilaraskan.
target_text: Before approving the next support package, planners asked US INDOPACOM [United States Indo-Pacific Command] to confirm where distribution timing needed adjustment.

source_text: Nota perhubungan daripada CFE-DM [Center for Excellence in Disaster Management and Humanitarian Assistance] menjelaskan permintaan mana yang telah disahkan sebelum sokongan rakan bergerak ke penempatan dataran banjir.
target_text: A liaison note from CFE-DM [Center for Excellence in Disaster Management and Humanitarian Assistance] clarified which requests were validated before partner support moved toward the floodplain settlements.

source_text: Kemas kini petang memasukkan AHA Centre [ASEAN Coordinating Centre for Humanitarian Assistance on disaster management] kerana pergerakan penduduk yang tidak pasti menjejaskan perancangan tempatan dan koordinasi serantau.
target_text: The evening update included AHA Centre [ASEAN Coordinating Centre for Humanitarian Assistance on disaster management] because uncertain population movement affected both local planning and regional coordination.

source_text: Selepas pasukan lapangan melaporkan kesesakan tempat perlindungan, UN OCHA [United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs] membantu memperhalusi permintaan sokongan untuk komun utara.
target_text: After field teams reported shelter crowding, UN OCHA [United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs] helped refine the support request for the northern communes.

source_text: ASEAN-ERAT [ASEAN Emergency Response and Assessment Team] menyertai perbincangan untuk mengesahkan sama ada penerbangan bantuan yang tertangguh telah mengubah jadual penilaian.
target_text: ASEAN-ERAT [ASEAN Emergency Response and Assessment Team] joined the discussion to validate whether delayed relief flights had changed the assessment schedule.

source_text: Pegawai daerah berunding dengan ACMC [Australian Civil-Military Centre] ketika menyelaraskan laporan tempat perlindungan dengan kekangan akses di ibu negeri wilayah.
target_text: District officials consulted ACMC [Australian Civil-Military Centre] while reconciling shelter reports with access constraints in the provincial capital.

source_text: Pemimpin komuniti membawa PDC [Pacific Disaster Center] ke dalam perbincangan kerana kawasan perindustrian yang rosak akibat banjir memerlukan pasukan penilaian yang lebih kecil.
target_text: community leaders brought PDC [Pacific Disaster Center] into the discussion because the flood-damaged industrial estate needed a smaller assessment team.

source_text: Nota perhubungan daripada WHO [World Health Organization] menjelaskan permintaan mana yang telah disahkan sebelum sokongan rakan bergerak ke kawasan pelabuhan yang rosak.
target_text: A liaison note from WHO [World Health Organization] clarified which requests were validated before partner support moved toward the damaged port area.

source_text: WFP [World Food Programme] melaras jadual penghantaran makanan selepas kelewatan penerbangan menjadikan lapangan terbang terlalu sesak untuk pergerakan kargo rutin.
target_text: WFP [World Food Programme] adjusted the food delivery schedule after flight delays made the airfield too congested for routine cargo movement.

source_text: Selepas pasukan lapangan melaporkan maklum balas komuniti, ISCG [Intersectoral Coordination Group] membantu memperhalusi permintaan sokongan untuk penempatan dataran banjir.
target_text: After field teams reported community feedback, ISCG [Intersectoral Coordination Group] helped refine the support request for the floodplain settlements.

source_text: Perancang membawa USAID BHA [United States Agency for International Development, Bureau for Humanitarian Assistance] ke dalam perbincangan apabila pergerakan penduduk yang tidak pasti mula menjejaskan pergerakan bantuan seterusnya.
target_text: Planners brought USAID BHA [United States Agency for International Development, Bureau for Humanitarian Assistance] into the discussion once uncertain population movement began affecting the next relief movement.

source_text: Pegawai daerah berunding dengan ADMM-Plus [ASEAN Defence Ministers' Meeting Plus] ketika menyelaraskan laporan tempat perlindungan dengan kekangan akses di komun utara.
target_text: District officials consulted ADMM-Plus [ASEAN Defence Ministers' Meeting Plus] while reconciling shelter reports with access constraints in the northern communes.
