source_text: MNCC menggunakan RFA yang disahkan untuk menetapkan sokongan ketenteraan asing sambil mengelakkan penduaan keupayaan tempatan.
target_text: The MNCC used validated RFAs to assign foreign military support while avoiding duplication of local capability.

source_text: Staf EOC beralih kepada komunikasi sandaran selepas kerosakan ribut mengganggu sambungan internet di beberapa daerah.
target_text: EOC staff shifted to backup communications after storm damage disrupted internet connectivity in several districts.

source_text: Proses RFA memastikan setiap aset yang diminta menangani jurang yang disahkan dan bukannya kebimbangan umum.
target_text: The RFA process ensured that every requested asset addressed a verified gap rather than a general concern.

source_text: COP memaparkan status jalan, kapasiti hospital, penghuni tempat perlindungan, kekangan logistik, dan tawaran bantuan tertunda.
target_text: The COP displayed road status, hospital capacity, shelter occupancy, logistics constraints, and pending assistance offers.

source_text: Komander SAR menghentikan sementara operasi sungai apabila keadaan cuaca menjadikan pencarian malam terlalu berbahaya untuk responden.
target_text: SAR commanders paused river operations when weather conditions made night search too dangerous for responders.

source_text: Pasukan USAR menandakan kawasan yang telah dibersihkan secara konsisten supaya kru yang tiba dapat memahami bahaya yang masih ada dan keutamaan pencarian.
target_text: USAR teams marked cleared areas consistently so incoming crews could understand remaining hazards and search priorities.

source_text: Penyelaras MSAR melibatkan komuniti nelayan kerana pengetahuan tempatan membantu memperhalusi anggaran hanyutan dan kawasan pencarian pesisir.
target_text: MSAR coordinators included fishing communities because local knowledge helped refine drift estimates and shoreline search areas.

source_text: Pakar CBRE menyemak label kontena dan corak saliran sebelum membuka semula laluan berhampiran zon perindustrian.
target_text: CBRE specialists reviewed container labels and drainage patterns before reopening a route near the industrial zone.

source_text: Penjejak IOI menunjukkan bahawa ketersediaan bahan api, kesesakan helikopter, dan kesesakan tempat perlindungan memerlukan keputusan peringkat kanan.
target_text: The IOI tracker showed that fuel availability, helicopter congestion, and shelter crowding required senior-level decisions.

source_text: Rakan kongsi WASH mengutamakan pengklorinan, penyelenggaraan tandas, dan mesej kebersihan selepas laporan air tidak selamat meningkat.
target_text: WASH partners prioritized chlorination, latrine maintenance, and hygiene messaging after reports of unsafe water increased.

source_text: Perancangan NFI mengambil kira saiz isi rumah, keperluan ketidakupayaan, penjagaan bayi, dan keluarga tanpa peralatan memasak.
target_text: NFI planning accounted for household size, disability needs, infant care, and families without cooking equipment.

source_text: HOC mengumpul maklum balas komuniti yang tidak kelihatan pada papan logistik dan pergerakan MNCC.
target_text: The HOC collected community feedback that was not visible in the MNCC logistics and movement boards.

source_text: Perancang LCC menyusun urutan kargo supaya bekalan perubatan, barangan rawatan air, dan bahan api bergerak sebelum bahan berkeutamaan lebih rendah.
target_text: LCC planners sequenced cargo so medical supplies, water treatment items, and fuel moved before lower-priority materials.

source_text: AIC mewajibkan pasukan dron menyerahkan pelan penerbangan kerana helikopter beroperasi berhampiran lembah yang sama.
target_text: The AIC required drone teams to submit flight plans because helicopters were operating near the same valley.

source_text: Prosedur MASCAS membantu hospital menyelaraskan kawasan triage, laluan pemindahan, dan penjejakan pesakit semasa latihan.
target_text: MASCAS procedures helped hospitals coordinate triage areas, transfer routes, and patient tracking during the exercise.

source_text: Mutual Recognition mengurangkan kelewatan pentadbiran untuk pasukan penyelamat bersijil sambil mengekalkan kuasa negara tuan rumah atas penugasan.
target_text: Mutual Recognition reduced administrative delays for certified rescue teams while preserving host-nation authority over tasking.

source_text: APOD memerlukan lebih banyak forklift selepas beberapa penerbangan bantuan tiba dengan kargo berpallet yang memerlukan pengendalian mekanikal.
target_text: The APOD needed more forklifts after multiple relief flights arrived with palletized cargo requiring mechanical handling.

source_text: Koordinasi SPOD menjadi penting apabila kapal yang membawa peralatan berat tiba ketika operasi pelabuhan komersial masih terganggu.
target_text: SPOD coordination became important when vessels carrying heavy equipment arrived while commercial port operations were still disrupted.

source_text: Penilaian MSR mempertimbangkan kekuatan jambatan, pendedahan tanah runtuh, ketersediaan bahan api, dan titik rehat yang selamat.
target_text: The MSR assessment considered bridge strength, landslide exposure, fuel availability, and safe rest points.

source_text: Koordinasi CIQ membantu pasukan masuk melepasi peralatan komunikasi, bekalan perubatan, dan alat penyelamat tanpa kelewatan yang tidak perlu.
target_text: CIQ coordination helped incoming teams clear communications gear, medical supplies, and rescue tools without unnecessary delay.

source_text: Perancang MCDA menyemak tugas sokongan setiap hari untuk memastikan bantuan ketenteraan kekal perlu dan berkadar.
target_text: MCDA planners reviewed support tasks daily to ensure military assistance remained necessary and proportionate.

source_text: Konsep HuMOCC membantu responden membincangkan perhubungan, perkongsian maklumat, dan sokongan tugas tanpa mengelirukan koordinasi dengan perintah.
target_text: HuMOCC concepts helped responders discuss liaison, information sharing, and task support without confusing coordination with command.

source_text: Prosedur DVI merangkumi pengurusan maklumat keluarga, perlindungan bukti, pertimbangan budaya, dan koordinasi dengan polis tempatan.
target_text: DVI procedures included family information management, evidence protection, cultural considerations, and coordination with local police.

source_text: Pegawai LEMA melaporkan bahawa tempat perlindungan tidak rasmi memerlukan pencahayaan, penyimpanan air, dan sokongan pendaftaran yang lebih jelas.
target_text: LEMA officials reported that informal shelters needed lighting, water storage, and clearer registration support.

source_text: Pengawal Ex COORES memperkenalkan gangguan komunikasi mendadak untuk menguji saluran pelaporan sandaran dan kebolehsuaian kepimpinan.
target_text: Ex COORES controllers introduced a sudden communications outage to test backup reporting channels and leadership adaptability.

source_text: TTX mendedahkan bahawa taklimat keputusan memerlukan pilihan yang lebih jelas apabila beberapa sektor meminta aset pengangkutan yang terhad.
target_text: The TTX revealed that decision briefs needed clearer options when multiple sectors requested scarce transport assets.

source_text: Entri OPERA CIS dikemas kini sebelum setiap mesyuarat supaya pemimpin tidak bertindak berdasarkan permintaan lapuk.
target_text: OPERA CIS entries were updated before each meeting so leaders would not act on outdated requests.

source_text: Langkah pengaktifan SASOP membimbing urutan daripada permintaan nasional hingga koordinasi serantau ASEAN.
target_text: SASOP activation steps guided the sequence from national request through ASEAN regional coordination.

source_text: SASOP Chapter VI membantu peserta membincangkan keperluan kastam, pergerakan, dan fasilitasi untuk aset ketenteraan.
target_text: SASOP Chapter VI helped participants discuss customs, movement, and facilitation requirements for military assets.

source_text: Komitmen AADMER menyokong perkongsian maklumat tepat pada masanya dan kerjasama antara pihak berkuasa pengurusan bencana ASEAN.
target_text: AADMER commitments supported timely information sharing and cooperation among ASEAN disaster management authorities.

source_text: Pengajaran ARDEX membentuk titik tekanan yang melibatkan perhatian media, kelewatan logistik, dan keutamaan sektor yang bersaing.
target_text: ARDEX lessons shaped the pressure points involving media attention, logistics delays, and competing sector priorities.

source_text: SME operasi kesihatan mencadangkan penghubungan pengawasan penyakit secara langsung dengan prosedur rujukan dan pengasingan.
target_text: The SME on health operations recommended linking disease surveillance directly to referral and isolation procedures.

source_text: Fasilitator AAR meminta setiap sel mengenal pasti satu penambahbaikan proses dan satu amalan yang wajar dikekalkan.
target_text: AAR facilitators asked each cell to identify one process improvement and one practice worth keeping.

source_text: GenAI menghasilkan draf nota taklimat daripada laporan panjang, tetapi staf membuang kenyataan yang tidak disokong atau kabur.
target_text: GenAI produced draft briefing notes from long reports, but staff removed unsupported or ambiguous statements.

source_text: LLM membantu membandingkan kemas kini berbilang bahasa supaya pasukan maklumat dapat mengelakkan salah terjemah kategori operasi.
target_text: The LLM helped compare multilingual updates so the information team could avoid mistranslating operational categories.

source_text: Produk Sentinel-1 memberi keyakinan kepada perancang bahawa laluan utara masih banjir walaupun akses darat terhad.
target_text: Sentinel-1 products gave planners confidence that the northern route remained flooded despite limited ground access.

source_text: Lapisan Copernicus ditambah ke dalam COP untuk membimbing pasukan pengesahan lapangan ke penempatan yang paling teruk terjejas.
target_text: Copernicus layers were added to the COP to guide field verification teams toward the hardest-hit settlements.

source_text: Digital Twin menunjukkan bahawa jambatan sementara boleh mengurangkan masa perjalanan ambulans lebih banyak daripada sokongan udara tambahan.
target_text: The Digital Twin showed that a temporary bridge could reduce ambulance travel time more than additional air support.

source_text: Perancangan Hybrid Exercise memerlukan penyelarasan masa inject dasar jarak jauh dengan aktiviti lapangan di APOD simulasi.
target_text: Hybrid Exercise planning required timing remote policy injects with field activities at the simulated APOD.

source_text: Cabaran interoperability muncul apabila rakan kongsi menggunakan format koordinat berbeza dan nama tidak rasmi untuk kampung yang sama.
target_text: Interoperability challenges appeared when partners used different coordinate formats and informal names for the same villages.

source_text: Information Overload kembali semasa inject gegaran susulan sehingga laporan ditapis melalui meja pengurusan maklumat.
target_text: Information Overload returned during the aftershock inject until reports were filtered through the information management desk.

source_text: ToR mewajibkan pegawai perhubungan menyerahkan kemas kini ringkas, mengenal pasti halangan, dan menandakan keputusan yang diperlukan daripada pemimpin.
target_text: The ToR required liaison officers to submit concise updates, identify blockers, and flag decisions needed from leaders.

source_text: Kelulusan CONOPS bergantung pada andaian tentang jendela cuaca, akses pelabuhan, keadaan keselamatan, dan keutamaan bantuan.
target_text: CONOPS approval depended on assumptions about weather windows, port access, security conditions, and relief priorities.

source_text: NFP memaklumkan rakan kongsi apabila pasukan perubatan diterima tetapi pakaian sumbangan tambahan ditolak.
target_text: The NFP notified partners when medical teams were accepted but additional donated clothing was declined.

source_text: Pasukan HADR melaraskan rancangan pengagihan selepas maklum balas komuniti menunjukkan satu laluan secara teknikal terbuka tetapi tidak selamat.
target_text: HADR teams adjusted distribution plans after community feedback showed that one route was technically open but unsafe.

source_text: Changi RHCC mengekalkan gambaran serantau aset yang ditawarkan, dikerahkan, tidak tersedia, atau menunggu penugasan.
target_text: The Changi RHCC maintained a regional overview of assets that were offered, deployed, unavailable, or awaiting tasking.

source_text: Keadaan di dusun pulau sungai memerlukan US INDOPACOM menjelaskan sama ada meja penerimaan yang terbeban mengubah urutan respons.
target_text: The situation in river-island hamlets required US INDOPACOM to clarify whether an overloaded reception desk changed the response sequence.

source_text: Pemerhati CFE-DM menekankan bagaimana agenda mesyuarat yang berdisiplin meningkatkan keputusan sepanjang tempoh latihan bertekanan tinggi.
target_text: CFE-DM observers highlighted how disciplined meeting agendas improved decisions during the high-pressure exercise period.

source_text: AHA Centre membantu menyampaikan pilihan sokongan ASEAN tanpa mewujudkan saluran permintaan selari untuk kerajaan terjejas.
target_text: The AHA Centre helped communicate ASEAN support options without creating parallel request channels for the affected government.

source_text: UN OCHA menyokong ringkasan keutamaan bersama yang menghubungkan keperluan kemanusiaan dengan kapasiti sektor dan kekangan operasi.
target_text: UN OCHA supported a shared priorities brief that linked humanitarian needs to sector capacity and operational constraints.

source_text: Pasukan ASEAN-ERAT mencadangkan penilaian lanjut di kampung yang pergerakan penduduknya tidak jelas selepas ribut.
target_text: ASEAN-ERAT teams recommended further assessment in villages where population movement was unclear after the storm.

source_text: Fasilitator ACMC membantu peserta membincangkan ketegangan antara sokongan ketenteraan yang pantas dan kebebasan kemanusiaan.
target_text: ACMC facilitators helped participants discuss the tension between rapid military support and humanitarian independence.

source_text: Pemodelan PDC menunjukkan bahawa jalan pesisir boleh banjir semula jika air pasang bertepatan dengan hujan baharu.
target_text: PDC modelling showed that coastal roads could flood again if high tide coincided with renewed rainfall.

source_text: WHO menyemak susun atur tempat perlindungan dan mencadangkan jarak lebih baik, kapasiti pengasingan, akses sanitasi, dan prosedur rujukan kesihatan.
target_text: WHO reviewed shelter layouts and recommended better spacing, isolation capacity, sanitation access, and health referral procedures.

source_text: WFP menyediakan laluan kontingensi untuk penghantaran makanan sekiranya banjir baharu menutup jalan akses utama gudang.
target_text: WFP prepared contingency routing for food deliveries in case renewed flooding closed the main warehouse access road.

source_text: ISCG bersetuju menggabungkan kemas kini sektor menjadi satu nota ringkas dan bukannya menghasilkan permintaan berasingan yang bertindih.
target_text: The ISCG agreed to combine sector updates into one concise note rather than producing separate overlapping requests.

source_text: USAID BHA mengutamakan rakan kongsi yang dapat menunjukkan koordinasi tempatan, keperluan yang dinilai, dan kapasiti penghantaran yang realistik.
target_text: USAID BHA prioritized partners that could show local coordination, assessed needs, and realistic delivery capacity.

source_text: Peserta ADMM-Plus menyatakan bahawa latihan perhubungan sama pentingnya dengan peralatan untuk sokongan HADR serantau yang berkesan.
target_text: ADMM-Plus participants noted that liaison training is as important as equipment for effective regional HADR support.

source_text: EWG on HADR mencadangkan prosedur serah tugas yang lebih jelas untuk pegawai perhubungan yang bergilir dalam sel koordinasi multinasional.
target_text: The EWG on HADR recommended clearer handover procedures for liaison officers rotating through multinational coordination cells.

source_text: Tanda INSARAG membantu kru masuk mengenali bilik yang telah dicari, bahaya yang dikenal pasti, dan lokasi yang memerlukan kerja teknikal lanjut.
target_text: INSARAG markings helped incoming crews recognize searched rooms, identified hazards, and locations requiring further technical work.

source_text: ASEAN Secretariat mengarkibkan output latihan supaya perancang masa depan dapat membandingkan kemajuan dengan cadangan terdahulu.
target_text: The ASEAN Secretariat archived exercise outputs so future planners could compare progress against earlier recommendations.

source_text: Laporan kesiapsiagaan AMRG on HADR merangkumi garis masa pengerahan, had sustainment, keupayaan pakar, dan kontak koordinasi.
target_text: AMRG on HADR readiness reports included deployment timelines, sustainment limits, specialist capabilities, and coordination contacts.

source_text: Personel SAF memberi nasihat tentang penerimaan lapangan terbang, pergerakan kargo, dan koordinasi antara staf penerbangan dengan pihak berkuasa awam.
target_text: SAF personnel advised on airfield reception, cargo movement, and coordination between aviation staff and civilian authorities.

source_text: Perancang kejuruteraan PLA memberikan batasan peralatan supaya MNCC dapat menetapkan tugas pembaikan jalan yang realistik.
target_text: PLA engineering planners provided equipment limitations so the MNCC could assign realistic road repair tasks.

source_text: JOCCA membantu mencegah penduaan dengan membandingkan tawaran serantau dengan keutamaan nasional dan permintaan bantuan yang belum selesai.
target_text: JOCCA helped prevent duplication by comparing regional offers with national priorities and pending assistance requests.

source_text: Mentor SCDF menyemak prosedur penyerahan mangsa dengan pasukan tempatan sebelum latihan struktur runtuh bermula.
target_text: SCDF mentors reviewed casualty handover procedures with local teams before the collapsed-structure drill began.

source_text: VINASARCOM memerlukan satu senarai keperluan terkini sebelum sebarang permintaan bantuan antarabangsa baharu dikeluarkan.
target_text: VINASARCOM required a single updated needs list before any new international assistance request was issued.

source_text: Kemas kini VDDMA menunjukkan bahawa satu bahagian sungai masih melebihi paras bahaya walaupun jumlah hujan menurun.
target_text: VDDMA updates showed that one river section remained above danger level despite falling rainfall totals.

source_text: Trak VPA mengangkut kargo bantuan ke hab hadapan selepas MOT mengesahkan bahawa laluan sekunder terbuka.
target_text: VPA trucks transported relief cargo to a forward hub after MOT confirmed that the secondary route was open.

source_text: MARD melaporkan bahawa pencegahan penyakit ternakan akan menjadi penting setelah operasi pemindahan stabil.
target_text: MARD reported that livestock disease prevention would become important once evacuation operations stabilized.

source_text: MOT memberi amaran kepada perancang konvoi bahawa jambatan yang dibaiki boleh menyokong ambulans tetapi bukan trak kargo bermuatan penuh.
target_text: MOT warned convoy planners that a repaired bridge could support ambulances but not fully loaded cargo trucks.

source_text: MOH meminta koordinasi tambahan dengan WHO mengenai pengawasan penyakit di tempat perlindungan dan prosedur rujukan pesakit.
target_text: MOH requested additional coordination with WHO on shelter disease surveillance and patient referral procedures.

source_text: Ahli DRRP mengenal pasti pengajaran kesiapsiagaan berkaitan amaran awal, latihan pemindahan, dan stok simpanan tempatan.
target_text: DRRP members identified preparedness lessons related to early warning, evacuation drills, and local stockpiles.

source_text: Peralatan yang disokong QPT membolehkan pasukan kampung mula membersihkan longkang kecil sebelum responden nasional tiba.
target_text: QPT-supported equipment allowed village teams to begin clearing small drains before national responders arrived.

source_text: Sukarelawan VNRC berkongsi maklum balas penerima manfaat yang menyebabkan perancang melaraskan masa penghantaran di dua pusat pemindahan.
target_text: VNRC volunteers shared beneficiary feedback that led planners to adjust delivery times at two evacuation centres.

source_text: VAMS mengemas kini sel kesihatan tentang tahap oksigen hospital, barisan ambulans, dan kapasiti pemindahan sebelum taklimat petang.
target_text: VAMS updated the health cell on hospital oxygen levels, ambulance queues, and transfer capacity before the evening briefing.

source_text: Koordinasi WoG mencegah mesej awam yang bercanggah tentang masa pemindahan, sekatan jalan, dan langkah kesihatan di tempat perlindungan.
target_text: WoG coordination prevented conflicting public messages on evacuation timing, road restrictions, and shelter health precautions.

source_text: NDMO memuktamadkan senarai keperluan rasmi selepas menyelaraskan laporan wilayah dengan dapatan penilaian lapangan.
target_text: The NDMO finalized the official needs list after reconciling provincial reports with field assessment findings.

source_text: Staf CMCoord membantu memastikan sokongan kejuruteraan ketenteraan ditugaskan kepada pemulihan akses dan bukannya kerja pembinaan umum.
target_text: CMCoord staff helped ensure military engineering support was assigned to access restoration rather than general construction work.

source_text: NFP menutup beberapa tawaran tertunda selepas mengesahkan bahawa sumber tempatan telah memenuhi keperluan yang dikenal pasti.
target_text: The NFP closed several pending offers after confirming that local resources had already met the identified requirements.

source_text: Penyelaras HADR mengelompokkan keperluan mendesak kepada kategori penyelamatan, kesihatan, logistik, tempat perlindungan, dan WASH sebelum menetapkan tindakan susulan.
target_text: HADR coordinators grouped urgent needs into rescue, health, logistics, shelter, and WASH categories before assigning follow-up actions.

source_text: Changi RHCC memberi taklimat kepada pegawai perhubungan rakan kongsi tentang bantuan yang diterima, jurang yang tinggal, dan keupayaan yang masih menunggu kelulusan negara tuan rumah.
target_text: The Changi RHCC briefed partner liaison officers on accepted assistance, remaining gaps, and capabilities still awaiting host-nation approval.

source_text: US INDOPACOM menawarkan sokongan perancangan untuk pergerakan udara selepas pihak berkuasa awam mengesahkan bahawa beberapa daerah masih tidak dapat dicapai melalui jalan raya.
target_text: US INDOPACOM offered planning support for air movement after civilian authorities confirmed that several districts remained inaccessible by road.

source_text: Nota rujukan CFE-DM membantu pasukan penilaian mengenal pasti sama ada masalah koordinasi berpunca daripada peranan yang tidak jelas atau aliran maklumat yang lemah.
target_text: CFE-DM reference notes helped the evaluation team identify whether coordination problems came from unclear roles or poor information flow.

source_text: AHA Centre mengemas kini rakan kongsi serantau selepas affected state mengesahkan keperluan tambahan untuk penulenan air dan tempat perlindungan sementara.
target_text: The AHA Centre updated regional partners after the affected state confirmed additional needs for water purification and temporary shelter.

source_text: UN OCHA bekerjasama dengan wakil kluster untuk menukar input lapangan yang panjang menjadi satu set keutamaan kemanusiaan yang ringkas.
target_text: UN OCHA worked with cluster representatives to turn lengthy field inputs into a concise set of humanitarian priorities.

source_text: ASEAN-ERAT mengesahkan laporan daripada pemimpin komuniti sebelum mencadangkan sama ada klinik bergerak patut melawat kampung terpencil dahulu.
target_text: ASEAN-ERAT verified reports from community leaders before recommending whether mobile clinics should visit the isolated villages first.

source_text: Panduan ACMC membantu pegawai tentera memahami mengapa kelajuan, keterlihatan, dan kawalan mesti diseimbangkan dengan prinsip kemanusiaan.
target_text: ACMC guidance helped military officers understand why speed, visibility, and control must be balanced with humanitarian principles.

source_text: Penganalisis PDC membandingkan ramalan laluan ribut dengan data penduduk terdedah untuk menandakan daerah pesisir yang memerlukan pengukuhan amaran awal.
target_text: PDC analysts compared storm-track forecasts with exposed population data to flag coastal districts needing early warning reinforcement.

source_text: WHO menasihati meja kesihatan tempat perlindungan supaya memantau pesakit penyakit kronik yang kehilangan akses kepada ubat biasa.
target_text: WHO advised the shelter health desk to monitor chronic disease patients who had lost access to regular medication.

source_text: WFP mengatur rancangan penghantaran berpecah supaya stok makanan dapat sampai ke tempat perlindungan besar dan tapak tidak rasmi yang lebih kecil.
target_text: WFP arranged a split delivery plan so food stocks could reach both large shelters and smaller informal sites.

source_text: ISCG meminta setiap sektor melaporkan kekangan utama, kapasiti tersedia, dan keputusan yang diperlukan sebelum panggilan koordinasi seterusnya.
target_text: The ISCG asked each sector to report top constraints, available capacity, and decisions required before the next coordination call.

source_text: USAID BHA membincangkan peta liputan rakan kongsi untuk memastikan aktiviti yang dibiayai penderma tidak meninggalkan kelompok keperluan yang terlepas pandang.
target_text: USAID BHA discussed partner coverage maps to ensure donor-funded activities did not leave overlooked pockets of need.

source_text: Ahli ADMM-Plus menyemak bagaimana kerjasama ketenteraan serantau dapat menyokong respons bencana sambil mengekalkan kepimpinan affected-state.
target_text: ADMM-Plus members reviewed how regional military cooperation could support disaster response while preserving affected-state leadership.

source_text: EWG on HADR meneliti sama ada templat umum dapat memperbaik cara pasukan rakan kongsi melaporkan aset tersedia.
target_text: The EWG on HADR examined whether common templates could improve the way partner forces reported available assets.

source_text: Prosedur koordinasi INSARAG memberi pasukan penyelamat yang tiba kaedah bersama untuk triage tapak dan penugasan worksite.
target_text: INSARAG coordination procedures gave arriving rescue teams a shared method for site triage and worksite assignment.

source_text: ASEAN Secretariat menyusun tugas susulan daripada mesyuarat serantau supaya ia dapat dijejaki selepas latihan.
target_text: The ASEAN Secretariat compiled follow-up tasks from the regional meeting so they could be tracked after the exercise.

source_text: Wakil AMRG on HADR membandingkan force package untuk pemindahan perubatan, pengangkutan, kejuruteraan, dan sokongan penulenan air.
target_text: AMRG on HADR representatives compared force packages for medical evacuation, transport, engineering, and water purification support.

source_text: Perancang SAF menyemak keadaan landasan, kapasiti pengendalian kargo, dan kesesakan lapangan terbang sebelum mencadangkan urutan penerbangan.
target_text: SAF planners reviewed runway conditions, cargo handling capacity, and airfield congestion before recommending flight sequencing.

source_text: Pegawai perhubungan PLA menerangkan keupayaan kejuruteraan dari segi penilaian jambatan, pembersihan runtuhan, dan pemulihan akses sementara.
target_text: The PLA liaison described engineering capabilities in terms of bridge assessment, debris clearance, and temporary access restoration.

source_text: JOCCA menterjemahkan kemas kini bantuan serantau menjadi satu ringkasan koordinasi untuk pembuat keputusan affected state.
target_text: JOCCA translated regional assistance updates into a single coordination brief for the affected state's decision-makers.

source_text: Mentor SCDF menekankan keperluan pemeriksaan keselamatan yang berdisiplin sebelum pasukan memasuki bangunan separa runtuh semasa gegaran susulan.
target_text: SCDF mentors emphasized the need for disciplined safety checks before teams entered partially collapsed buildings during aftershocks.

source_text: VINASARCOM meminta laporan wilayah yang dikemas kini sebelum meluluskan gelombang kedua tawaran bantuan antarabangsa.
target_text: VINASARCOM requested updated provincial reports before approving a second wave of international assistance offers.

source_text: Jurutera VDDMA memberi amaran bahawa benteng tepu boleh gagal walaupun jumlah hujan mula menurun.
target_text: VDDMA engineers warned that saturated embankments could fail even if rainfall totals began to decline.

source_text: Unit VPA menyokong pembersihan laluan sementara pegawai tempatan mengenal pasti komuniti mana yang memerlukan jalan dibuka semula dahulu.
target_text: VPA units supported route clearance while local officials identified which communities needed the road reopened first.

source_text: MARD melaporkan bahawa pam pengairan yang rosak boleh melambatkan pemulihan pertanian lama selepas tempat perlindungan kecemasan ditutup.
target_text: MARD reported that damaged irrigation pumps could delay agricultural recovery long after emergency shelters closed.

source_text: Pengurus trafik MOT berkoordinasi dengan polis untuk mengawal pergerakan konvoi melalui jalan sempit dan separa rosak.
target_text: MOT traffic managers coordinated with police to control convoy movement through narrow and partially damaged roads.

source_text: MOH meminta hospital melaporkan stok oksigen, kapasiti trauma, dan kelewatan ambulans setiap empat jam.
target_text: MOH asked hospitals to report oxygen stocks, trauma capacity, and ambulance delays every four hours.

source_text: Ahli DRRP mencadangkan penggunaan pengajaran respons untuk mengukuhkan pelan kesiapsiagaan tempatan sebelum musim taufan seterusnya.
target_text: DRRP members proposed using response lessons to strengthen local preparedness plans before the next typhoon season.

source_text: Pelaburan QPT dalam sistem amaran kampung membantu penduduk berpindah sebelum air banjir sampai ke jalan akses utama.
target_text: QPT investments in village warning systems helped residents evacuate before floodwater reached the main access road.

source_text: Pasukan VNRC mengumpul maklum balas komuniti tentang masa pengagihan, keadaan tempat perlindungan, dan ahli keluarga yang hilang.
target_text: VNRC teams collected community feedback on distribution timing, shelter conditions, and missing family members.

source_text: VAMS mengenal pasti bottleneck rujukan selepas dua hospital daerah melaporkan barisan ambulans dan kapasiti pembedahan terhad.
target_text: VAMS identified referral bottlenecks after two district hospitals reported ambulance queues and limited surgical capacity.

source_text: Perancangan WoG membantu kementerian menyelesaikan keutamaan bersaing antara pembersihan jalan, sokongan hospital, penghantaran makanan, dan pengurusan tempat perlindungan.
target_text: WoG planning helped ministries resolve competing priorities between road clearance, hospital support, food delivery, and shelter management.

source_text: NDMO menapis tawaran antarabangsa melalui senarai keperluan rasmi sebelum berkongsi cadangan penugasan dengan rakan kongsi.
target_text: The NDMO filtered international offers through the official needs list before sharing tasking recommendations with partners.

source_text: Staf CMCoord menjelaskan bagaimana trak tentera boleh menyokong penghantaran kemanusiaan tanpa mengubah pelan pengagihan awam.
target_text: CMCoord staff explained how military trucks could support humanitarian deliveries without changing the civilian distribution plan.

source_text: Komunikasi Mil-Mil membantu kontinjen rakan kongsi menyelaraskan kawasan staging tanpa menambah tekanan kepada pusat operasi awam.
target_text: Mil-Mil communication helped partner contingents coordinate staging areas without adding pressure to the civilian operations centre.

source_text: Mesyuarat perhubungan Civ-Mil memberi NGO tempatan saluran untuk membangkitkan masalah akses sebelum arahan pergerakan tentera dikeluarkan.
target_text: Civ-Mil liaison meetings gave local NGOs a channel to raise access problems before military movement orders were issued.

source_text: Sebagai AS [Negara Terjejas], kerajaan mengesahkan bahawa semua pasukan masuk akan beroperasi di bawah keutamaan pengurusan bencana nasional.
target_text: As the AS [Affected State], the government confirmed that all incoming teams would operate under national disaster management priorities.

source_text: MNCC menjejaki permintaan sokongan ketenteraan asing dari kelulusan hingga selesai supaya tiada pesawat atau pasukan kejuruteraan diberi tugas berganda.
target_text: The MNCC tracked foreign military support requests from approval through completion so no aircraft or engineering team was double-tasked.

source_text: Pengurus EOC menggunakan kemas kini daerah untuk memutuskan sama ada sokongan pemindahan atau bekalan semula hospital perlu dieskalasi segera.
target_text: EOC managers used district updates to decide whether evacuation support or hospital resupply needed immediate escalation.

source_text: RFA untuk airlift menerangkan jenis kargo, jumlah penumpang, titik pemuatan, destinasi, dan kepekaan masa.
target_text: The RFA for airlift described cargo type, passenger numbers, loading point, destination, and time sensitivity.

source_text: COP memasukkan tahap keyakinan untuk peta banjir, laporan jalan, angka tempat perlindungan, dan anggaran kapasiti hospital.
target_text: The COP included confidence levels for flood maps, road reports, shelter figures, and hospital capacity estimates.

source_text: Pasukan SAR berkoordinasi dengan pemimpin kampung untuk mengenal pasti rumah di mana penduduk mungkin mengabaikan arahan pemindahan.
target_text: SAR teams coordinated with village leaders to identify homes where residents might have ignored evacuation orders.

source_text: Kru USAR meminta maklumat struktur terkini sebelum memasuki blok pejabat yang rosak berhampiran tebing sungai.
target_text: USAR crews requested updated structural information before entering the damaged office block near the riverfront.

source_text: Perancang MSAR melaraskan kawasan pencarian selepas data angin dan pasang surut mengubah anggaran hanyutan semalaman.
target_text: MSAR planners adjusted the search area after wind and tide data changed overnight drift estimates.

source_text: Responden CBRE menetapkan perimeter keselamatan di sekitar gudang sehingga keputusan pemantauan udara tersedia.
target_text: CBRE responders established a safety perimeter around the warehouse until air monitoring results were available.

source_text: Papan IOI menyenaraikan keputusan belum selesai tentang urutan penerbangan bantuan, kelewatan kastam, kesesakan tempat perlindungan, dan mesej awam.
target_text: The IOI board listed unresolved decisions on relief flight sequencing, customs delays, shelter crowding, and public messaging.

source_text: Rakan kongsi WASH mengutamakan penyimpanan air selamat kerana sesetengah keluarga menggunakan semula bekas tercemar di pusat pemindahan.
target_text: WASH partners prioritized safe water storage because some families were reusing contaminated containers in evacuation centres.

source_text: Kerani logistik menghubungkan NFI kepada nota penyerahan yang lebih baik selepas laporan dari dusun pulau sungai berubah semalaman.
target_text: logistics clerks linked NFI to a better handover note after reports from river-island hamlets changed overnight.

source_text: HOC mengumpul kebimbangan perlindungan daripada rakan kongsi kemanusiaan sebelum memberi taklimat kepada elemen koordinasi ketenteraan.
target_text: The HOC gathered protection concerns from humanitarian partners before briefing the military coordination element.

source_text: Pegawai LCC membandingkan kapasiti konvoi dengan permintaan kargo mendesak sebelum melepaskan trak ke hab hadapan.
target_text: LCC officers compared convoy capacity with urgent cargo requests before releasing trucks to the forward hub.

source_text: AIC menangguhkan misi dron tinjauan sehingga helikopter pemindahan perubatan membersihkan koridor udara berhampiran.
target_text: The AIC delayed a survey drone mission until medical evacuation helicopters cleared the nearby air corridor.

source_text: Inject MASCAS menguji sama ada penghantar ambulans boleh menghala pesakit apabila dua hospital mencapai kapasiti serentak.
target_text: MASCAS injects tested whether ambulance dispatchers could route patients when two hospitals reached capacity simultaneously.

source_text: Mutual Recognition membantu negara tuan rumah mengintegrasikan pasukan penyelamat bersijil tanpa mengulangi semakan kelayakan penuh.
target_text: Mutual Recognition helped the host nation integrate certified rescue teams without repeating full qualification reviews.

source_text: Pasukan APOD mewujudkan lorong berasingan untuk penerimaan personel, pengendalian kargo, dan penugasan pengangkutan seterusnya.
target_text: The APOD team created separate lanes for personnel reception, cargo handling, and onward transport assignment.

source_text: Pengurus SPOD menjadualkan pemunggahan peralatan berat pada waktu malam untuk mengurangkan gangguan terhadap pergerakan kargo bantuan siang hari.
target_text: SPOD managers scheduled heavy equipment offload at night to reduce interference with daytime relief cargo movement.

source_text: MSR dibuka semula selepas jurutera memasang saliran sementara dan membersihkan lumpur dari bahagian paling curam.
target_text: The MSR reopened after engineers installed temporary drainage and cleared mud from the steepest section.

source_text: Pemprosesan CIQ bertambah baik apabila pasukan masuk menyerahkan senarai peralatan, bekalan perubatan, dan butiran pasport sebelum berlepas.
target_text: CIQ processing improved when incoming teams submitted equipment lists, medical supplies, and passport details before departure.

source_text: Permintaan MCDA dihadkan kepada jurang sensitif masa yang tidak dapat ditangani oleh responden awam dengan sumber tersedia.
target_text: MCDA requests were limited to time-sensitive gaps that civilian responders could not address with available resources.

source_text: Prinsip HuMOCC memberi sel koordinasi bahasa neutral untuk membincangkan sokongan ketenteraan kepada tugas kemanusiaan.
target_text: HuMOCC principles gave the coordination cell a neutral language for discussing military support to humanitarian tasks.

source_text: Personel DVI bekerjasama dengan pihak berkuasa tempatan untuk merekod maklumat orang hilang dan mengurus prosedur pengenalpastian dengan hormat.
target_text: DVI personnel worked with local authorities to record missing-person information and manage identification procedures respectfully.

source_text: LEMA memaklumkan perancang nasional bahawa satu pusat pemindahan yang disenaraikan tidak mempunyai bekalan air dan tidak sepatutnya menerima lebih banyak keluarga.
target_text: LEMA informed national planners that one listed evacuation centre had no water supply and should not receive more families.

source_text: Penilai Ex COORES memerhati betapa cepat peserta mengenali tawaran berganda dan mengalihkan sokongan kepada keperluan yang belum dipenuhi.
target_text: Ex COORES evaluators observed how quickly participants recognized duplicated offers and redirected support to unmet needs.

source_text: TTX mencabar pegawai untuk mengutamakan antara airlift bagi bekalan perubatan dan sokongan kejuruteraan untuk jambatan yang rosak.
target_text: The TTX challenged officials to prioritize between airlift for medical supplies and engineering support for a damaged bridge.

source_text: Entri OPERA CIS membantu pasukan maklumat melihat permintaan mana yang memerlukan penjelasan sebelum dapat ditugaskan.
target_text: OPERA CIS entries helped the information team see which requests needed clarification before they could be tasked.

source_text: Panduan SASOP menyokong perbincangan tentang bagaimana pengaturan siap siaga ASEAN harus diminta, difasilitasi, dan dilaporkan.
target_text: SASOP guidance supported the discussion on how ASEAN standby arrangements should be requested, facilitated, and reported.

source_text: SASOP Chapter VI membantu penasihat undang-undang menjelaskan keperluan untuk menerima dan menyelaraskan aset ketenteraan asing.
target_text: SASOP Chapter VI helped legal advisers explain requirements for receiving and coordinating foreign military assets.

source_text: AADMER digunakan sebagai rujukan dasar untuk kerjasama serantau, bantuan bersama, dan perkongsian maklumat.
target_text: AADMER was used as the policy reference for regional cooperation, mutual assistance, and information sharing.

source_text: Pengajaran ARDEX mempengaruhi keputusan untuk memasukkan gangguan pelabuhan, banjir, dan inject kesihatan awam secara serentak.
target_text: ARDEX lessons influenced the decision to include simultaneous port disruption, flooding, and public health injects.

source_text: SME mencadangkan bahawa senario masa depan memasukkan lebih banyak tekanan kepada pengurus maklumat semasa tempoh laporan puncak.
target_text: The SME recommended that future scenarios include more pressure on information managers during peak reporting periods.

source_text: AAR mengenal pasti jurang dalam serah tugas syif perhubungan, prosedur penutupan tugas, dan kualiti ringkasan sektor.
target_text: The AAR identified gaps in liaison shift handovers, task closure procedures, and the quality of sector summaries.

source_text: GenAI menghasilkan draf pertama ringkasan situasi, tetapi penganalisis menyemak setiap baris dengan laporan yang disahkan.
target_text: GenAI produced a first draft of the situation summary, but analysts checked every line against verified reports.

source_text: LLM membantu menukar nota penilaian teknikal menjadi kemas kini bahasa mudah untuk taklimat koordinasi.
target_text: The LLM helped convert technical assessment notes into plain-language updates for the coordination briefing.

source_text: Imejan radar Sentinel-1 menyokong pemetaan banjir apabila rondaan darat tidak dapat mencapai lembangan sungai utara.
target_text: Sentinel-1 radar imagery supported flood mapping when ground patrols could not reach the northern river basin.

source_text: Produk Copernicus membantu membandingkan penempatan terjejas, jalan rosak, dan kemungkinan kekangan akses di seluruh wilayah.
target_text: Copernicus products helped compare affected settlements, damaged roads, and likely access constraints across the province.

source_text: Digital Twin membolehkan perancang menguji sama ada memindahkan kawasan staging akan memendekkan masa penghantaran.
target_text: The Digital Twin allowed planners to test whether moving the staging area would shorten delivery times.

source_text: Hybrid Exercise menggabungkan penyelesaian masalah tahap dasar dengan tugas penerimaan tahap lapangan di lapangan terbang simulasi.
target_text: The Hybrid Exercise combined policy-level problem solving with field-level reception tasks at the simulated airport.

source_text: Masalah interoperability berkurang setelah semua pasukan menggunakan tajuk hamparan dan pengecam daerah yang sama.
target_text: Interoperability problems decreased once all teams used the same spreadsheet headings and district identifiers.

source_text: Information Overload meningkat apabila foto tidak ditapis, nota mentah, dan laporan pendua sampai kepada pasukan taklimat kanan.
target_text: Information Overload increased when unfiltered photographs, raw notes, and duplicate reports reached the senior briefing team.

source_text: ToR mewajibkan setiap ketua sel memberikan kemas kini ringkas dan mengenal pasti keputusan yang memerlukan perhatian kepimpinan.
target_text: The ToR required each cell lead to provide concise updates and identify decisions that needed leadership attention.

source_text: Andaian CONOPS disemak semula selepas ramalan cuaca baharu memendekkan jendela yang tersedia untuk operasi helikopter.
target_text: CONOPS assumptions were revised after new weather forecasts shortened the available window for helicopter operations.

source_text: NFP mengakui tawaran baharu hanya selepas mengesahkan sama ada tawaran itu sepadan dengan senarai keperluan sahih terkini.
target_text: The NFP acknowledged new offers only after confirming whether they matched the latest validated needs list.

source_text: Pasukan HADR beralih daripada respons pantas kepada penstabilan setelah operasi penyelamatan berakhir dan perkhidmatan tempat perlindungan menjadi keutamaan utama.
target_text: HADR teams shifted from rapid response to stabilization once rescue operations ended and shelter services became the main priority.

source_text: Changi RHCC membantu mengekalkan kesedaran situasi serantau dengan membandingkan keupayaan rakan kongsi dengan RFA yang diterima.
target_text: The Changi RHCC helped maintain regional situational awareness by comparing partner capabilities with accepted RFAs.

source_text: Perancang US INDOPACOM berkongsi kekangan pesawat supaya MNCC dapat mengelakkan penugasan misi kargo yang tidak sesuai.
target_text: US INDOPACOM planners shared aircraft constraints so the MNCC could avoid assigning unsuitable cargo missions.

source_text: Bahan CFE-DM menyokong perbincangan tentang mengapa disiplin maklumat penting semasa operasi multinasional yang bergerak pantas.
target_text: CFE-DM materials supported a discussion on why information discipline matters during fast-moving multinational operations.

source_text: AHA Centre berkoordinasi dengan NDMO untuk mengemas kini rakan kongsi ASEAN tentang jurang logistik dan keutamaan tempat perlindungan.
target_text: The AHA Centre coordinated with the NDMO to update ASEAN partners on logistics gaps and shelter priorities.

source_text: UN OCHA membantu rakan kongsi menyediakan mesej bersama tentang akses kemanusiaan dan bantuan yang tidak berat sebelah.
target_text: UN OCHA helped partners prepare a joint message on humanitarian access and impartial assistance.

source_text: Dapatan ASEAN-ERAT menunjukkan bahawa sesetengah kampung memerlukan outreach perubatan dengan lebih segera berbanding bekalan makanan tambahan.
target_text: ASEAN-ERAT findings showed that some villages needed medical outreach more urgently than additional food supplies.

source_text: Penasihat ACMC menggalakkan perancang mendokumentasikan andaian setiap kali aset ketenteraan digunakan untuk tugas bantuan awam.
target_text: ACMC advisers encouraged planners to document assumptions whenever military assets were used for civilian relief tasks.

source_text: Pemodelan PDC menonjolkan bahawa satu daerah menghadapi pendedahan banjir dan redundansi laluan pemindahan yang terhad.
target_text: PDC modelling highlighted that one district faced both flood exposure and limited evacuation-route redundancy.

source_text: WHO mencadangkan pasukan kesihatan memetakan pilihan rujukan untuk dialisis, penjagaan bersalin, dan rawatan trauma.
target_text: WHO recommended that health teams map referral options for dialysis, maternity care, and trauma treatment.

source_text: WFP berkoordinasi dengan penyedia pengangkutan tempatan selepas kapasiti trak komersial menjadi kekangan operasi utama.
target_text: WFP coordinated with local transport providers after commercial trucking capacity became a major operational constraint.

source_text: ISCG menyatukan keperluan sektor supaya penderma dapat membandingkan jurang mendesak tanpa membaca laporan teknikal berasingan.
target_text: The ISCG consolidated sector needs so donors could compare urgent gaps without reading separate technical reports.

source_text: USAID BHA menyemak sama ada aktiviti yang dicadangkan merangkumi koordinasi dengan pihak berkuasa tempatan dan garis masa penghantaran yang realistik.
target_text: USAID BHA reviewed whether proposed activities included coordination with local authorities and realistic delivery timelines.

source_text: Pemerhati ADMM-Plus menyatakan bahawa prosedur bersama meningkatkan kepercayaan sebelum tekanan operasi meningkat semasa senario.
target_text: ADMM-Plus observers noted that common procedures improved trust before operational pressure increased during the scenario.

source_text: EWG on HADR mencadangkan latihan semula yang lebih kerap untuk koordinasi logistik multinasional semasa latihan serantau.
target_text: The EWG on HADR recommended more frequent rehearsal of multinational logistics coordination during regional exercises.

source_text: Pengurusan worksite INSARAG mengurangkan kekeliruan apabila beberapa pasukan penyelamat tiba di struktur runtuh yang sama.
target_text: INSARAG worksite management reduced confusion when multiple rescue teams arrived at the same collapsed structure.

source_text: ASEAN Secretariat menyimpan rekod rasmi keputusan untuk tindakan susulan semasa mesyuarat HADR serantau akan datang.
target_text: The ASEAN Secretariat preserved the official record of decisions for follow-up during future regional HADR meetings.

source_text: Peserta AMRG on HADR meneliti sama ada unit yang boleh dikerahkan mempunyai self-sustainment yang mencukupi untuk operasi terpencil.
target_text: AMRG on HADR participants examined whether deployable units had enough self-sustainment for remote operations.

source_text: Pasukan SAF berkongsi pengalaman tentang mengintegrasikan perancangan pemindahan perubatan dengan prosedur penerimaan lapangan terbang.
target_text: SAF teams shared experience on integrating medical evacuation planning with airfield reception procedures.

source_text: Jurutera PLA meminta data tinjauan tempatan sebelum mengerahkan peralatan ke lintasan sungai yang rosak.
target_text: PLA engineers requested local survey data before committing equipment to the damaged river crossing.

source_text: JOCCA membantu mengenal pasti bila tawaran serantau harus dialihkan kerana keperluan asal telah dipenuhi.
target_text: JOCCA helped identify when a regional offer should be redirected because the original need had already been met.

source_text: Pengajar SCDF menyemak protokol komunikasi penyelamatan teknikal dengan pasukan tempatan sebelum latihan malam.
target_text: SCDF instructors reviewed technical rescue communication protocols with local teams before the night exercise.

source_text: VINASARCOM menyelaraskan kelulusan nasional supaya rakan kongsi antarabangsa tidak berunding secara berasingan dengan beberapa wilayah.
target_text: VINASARCOM coordinated national approvals so international partners would not negotiate separately with multiple provinces.

source_text: Kemas kini VDDMA membantu perancang pemindahan menjangka kawasan rendah mana yang boleh banjir semula selepas pelepasan empangan.
target_text: VDDMA updates helped evacuation planners anticipate which low-lying areas could flood again after dam releases.

source_text: Sokongan logistik VPA membolehkan barang bantuan bergerak melepasi titik di mana trak awam dapat beroperasi dengan selamat.
target_text: VPA logistics support allowed relief items to move beyond the point where civilian trucks could safely operate.

source_text: Laporan kerosakan MARD menyokong perancangan untuk kesihatan haiwan, penggantian benih, dan pemulihan sistem pengairan.
target_text: MARD damage reports supported planning for animal health, seed replacement, and restoration of irrigation systems.

source_text: MOT memaklumkan LCC bahawa dua jalan sekunder terbuka hanya untuk kenderaan ringan.
target_text: MOT informed the LCC that two secondary roads were open only to light vehicles.

source_text: MOH meminta sel koordinasi kesihatan bersedia menghadapi peningkatan penyakit berkaitan tempat perlindungan sepanjang minggu berikutnya.
target_text: MOH asked the health coordination cell to prepare for increased shelter-related illness over the next week.

source_text: Rakan kongsi DRRP mencadangkan latihan komuniti berdasarkan jurang yang diperhatikan dalam amaran awal dan tingkah laku pemindahan.
target_text: DRRP partners proposed community training based on gaps observed in early warning and evacuation behavior.

source_text: Aktiviti kesiapsiagaan yang disokong QPT membantu sukarelawan tempatan mengurus pemindahan awal sebelum sumber nasional tiba.
target_text: QPT-supported preparedness activities helped local volunteers manage initial evacuation before national resources arrived.

source_text: Staf cawangan VNRC membantu pengurus tempat perlindungan mengenal pasti kanak-kanak terpisah, warga emas yang dipindahkan, dan keluarga yang memerlukan bantuan khas.
target_text: VNRC branch staff helped shelter managers identify separated children, older evacuees, and families requiring special assistance.

source_text: VAMS mencadangkan penambahan penunjuk status ambulans pada papan pemuka kesihatan bersama yang digunakan oleh EOC.
target_text: VAMS recommended adding ambulance status indicators to the shared health dashboard used by the EOC.

source_text: Koordinasi WoG mengurangkan kekeliruan apabila kementerian perlu mengeluarkan arahan bersama tentang pemindahan, penutupan jalan, dan langkah kesihatan.
target_text: WoG coordination reduced confusion when ministries had to issue joint instructions on evacuation, road closures, and health precautions.

source_text: NDMO meminta rakan kongsi menjelaskan sama ada tawaran mereka merangkumi pengangkutan, bahan api, jurubahasa, dan self-sustainment.
target_text: The NDMO asked partners to clarify whether their offers included transport, fuel, interpreters, and self-sustainment.

source_text: Perbincangan CMCoord membantu menukar permintaan sokongan yang luas menjadi tugas khusus untuk trak, helikopter, dan jurutera.
target_text: CMCoord discussions helped convert a broad request for support into specific tasks for trucks, helicopters, and engineers.

source_text: Saluran Mil-Mil menyahkonflik parkir dan pengisian bahan api helikopter sebelum kesesakan menjejaskan pergerakan udara kemanusiaan.
target_text: Mil-Mil channels deconflicted helicopter parking and refuelling before congestion affected humanitarian air movements.

source_text: Koordinasi Civ-Mil memastikan pergerakan konvoi tidak menghalang akses ke titik pengagihan awam.
target_text: Civ-Mil coordination ensured that convoy movements did not block access to civilian distribution points.

source_text: AS [Negara Terjejas] meminta semua pasukan antarabangsa berkongsi rancangan harian sebelum bergerak keluar dari kawasan yang ditugaskan.
target_text: The AS [Affected State] requested that all international teams share daily plans before moving outside assigned areas.

source_text: MNCC berkoordinasi dengan HOC untuk memastikan sokongan logistik ketenteraan sejajar dengan keutamaan kemanusiaan awam.
target_text: The MNCC coordinated with the HOC to ensure military logistics support aligned with civilian humanitarian priorities.

source_text: Staf EOC mengemas kini peta insiden selepas pasukan lapangan mengesahkan tiga jambatan hanya boleh digunakan oleh kenderaan kecil.
target_text: EOC staff updated the incident map after field teams confirmed three bridges were usable only for small vehicles.

source_text: RFA untuk sokongan rawatan air diutamakan selepas laporan WASH menunjukkan risiko kesihatan meningkat di tempat perlindungan.
target_text: An RFA for water treatment support was prioritized after WASH reports showed rising health risks in shelters.

source_text: COP membantu pemimpin membandingkan keperluan yang disahkan dengan aset tersedia sebelum memilih keutamaan operasi seterusnya.
target_text: The COP helped leaders compare verified needs against available assets before choosing the next operational priorities.

source_text: Operasi SAR beralih kepada pencarian sekunder selepas pihak berkuasa tempatan mengesahkan bahawa penyelamatan segera yang mengancam nyawa telah selesai.
target_text: SAR operations moved to secondary search after local authorities confirmed that immediate life-threatening rescues were complete.

source_text: Pasukan USAR berkoordinasi dengan pakar DVI apabila operasi pencarian beralih daripada penyelamatan kepada pemulihan di satu bangunan.
target_text: USAR teams coordinated with DVI specialists when search operations shifted from rescue to recovery in one building.

source_text: Unit MSAR melaraskan corak bot selepas keadaan cuaca menjadikan grid pencarian asal tidak selamat.
target_text: MSAR units adjusted boat patterns after weather conditions made the original search grid unsafe.

source_text: Bahaya CBRE diketepikan sebelum tapak gudang diluluskan untuk penyimpanan bantuan sementara.
target_text: CBRE hazards were ruled out before the warehouse site was approved for temporary relief storage.

source_text: Penjejak IOI membantu pembuat keputusan melihat isu mana yang memerlukan panduan dasar dan bukannya tindakan operasi rutin.
target_text: The IOI tracker helped decision-makers see which issues required policy guidance rather than routine operational action.

source_text: Pasukan WASH berkoordinasi dengan MOH kerana sanitasi buruk di tempat perlindungan boleh cepat menjadi masalah kesihatan awam.
target_text: WASH teams coordinated with MOH because poor sanitation in shelters could quickly become a public health problem.

source_text: Tahap stok NFI dikemas kini sebelum perancang menetapkan selimut, kit kebersihan, dan set dapur tambahan.
target_text: NFI stock levels were updated before planners committed additional blankets, hygiene kits, and kitchen sets.

source_text: HOC mengeskalasi kebimbangan komuniti tentang keadilan pengagihan yang tidak kelihatan dalam laporan logistik.
target_text: The HOC escalated community concerns about distribution equity that were not visible in logistics reports.

source_text: Perancang LCC menetapkan trak terhad berdasarkan kemendesakan kargo, akses destinasi, dan kapasiti pemunggahan.
target_text: LCC planners assigned scarce trucks based on cargo urgency, destination access, and unloading capacity.

source_text: Koordinasi AIC mencegah sorti pemetaan dron bercanggah dengan pemindahan perubatan helikopter di sepanjang laluan yang sama.
target_text: AIC coordination prevented a drone mapping sortie from conflicting with helicopter medical evacuation along the same route.

source_text: Prosedur MASCAS membimbing triage apabila latihan memperkenalkan kecederaan serentak daripada jambatan runtuh dan banjir.
target_text: MASCAS procedures guided triage when the exercise introduced simultaneous injuries from a bridge collapse and flooding.

source_text: Mutual Recognition membolehkan pasukan koordinasi mempercayai keupayaan penyelamat bersijil sambil tetap menetapkan misi secara tempatan.
target_text: Mutual Recognition allowed the coordination team to trust certified rescue capabilities while still assigning missions locally.

source_text: Pasukan penerimaan APOD memerlukan papan tanda lebih jelas supaya responden yang tiba dapat mencari kawasan pendaftaran, taklimat, dan pengangkutan dengan cepat.
target_text: The APOD reception team needed clearer signage so arriving responders could find registration, briefing, and transport areas quickly.

source_text: Kelewatan SPOD memaksa LCC mengutamakan kargo berat mana yang harus bergerak dahulu setelah berth dibuka semula.
target_text: SPOD delays forced the LCC to prioritize which heavy cargo should move first once the berth reopened.

source_text: MSR kekal rentan kerana satu bahagian curam boleh tertutup semula jika hujan melonggarkan cerun.
target_text: The MSR remained vulnerable because one steep section could close again if rain loosened the slope.

source_text: Pegawai CIQ berkoordinasi dengan NFP untuk memproses personel bantuan yang diluluskan tanpa melambatkan pasukan mendesak.
target_text: CIQ officers coordinated with the NFP to process approved relief personnel without delaying urgent teams.

source_text: Sokongan MCDA disemak berdasarkan keperluan kemanusiaan, kapasiti awam, dan kemungkinan tempoh jurang tersebut.
target_text: MCDA support was reviewed against humanitarian need, civilian capacity, and the likely duration of the gap.

source_text: Panduan HuMOCC membantu mencegah salah faham apabila perancang tentera menghadiri mesyuarat koordinasi kemanusiaan.
target_text: HuMOCC guidance helped prevent misunderstandings when military planners attended humanitarian coordination meetings.

source_text: Pasukan DVI meminta jurubahasa supaya temu bual keluarga dapat dijalankan dengan tepat dan hormat.
target_text: DVI teams requested interpreters so family interviews could be conducted accurately and respectfully.

source_text: LEMA melaporkan bahawa sukarelawan kampung telah membuka tempat perlindungan baharu yang belum disenaraikan dalam rekod nasional.
target_text: LEMA reported that village volunteers had opened a new shelter not yet listed in national records.

source_text: Pengawal Ex COORES menambah inject kekurangan bahan api untuk menguji pengutamaan logistik dan koordinasi rakan kongsi.
target_text: Ex COORES controllers added a fuel shortage inject to test logistics prioritization and partner coordination.

source_text: TTX menunjukkan bahawa peserta memerlukan proses yang lebih jelas untuk menutup permintaan yang tidak lagi relevan.
target_text: The TTX showed that participants needed a clearer process for closing requests that were no longer relevant.

source_text: OPERA CIS membantu menjejaki sama ada tawaran masih menunggu kelulusan negara tuan rumah atau sudah sedia untuk penugasan.
target_text: OPERA CIS helped track whether offers were still pending host-nation approval or ready for tasking.

source_text: Rujukan SASOP membantu pasukan menyelaraskan prosedur sokongan ASEAN dengan proses permintaan nasional affected state.
target_text: SASOP references helped the team align ASEAN support procedures with the affected state's national request process.

source_text: SASOP Chapter VI dirujuk ketika membincangkan bagaimana peralatan ketenteraan harus melalui pelepasan masuk dan bergerak ke tugas yang ditetapkan.
target_text: SASOP Chapter VI was cited when discussing how military equipment should clear entry and move to assigned tasks.

source_text: Prinsip AADMER menegaskan bahawa bantuan serantau harus menyokong kepimpinan nasional dan mengukuhkan kerjasama antara negara anggota.
target_text: AADMER principles reinforced that regional assistance should support national leadership and strengthen cooperation among member states.

source_text: Pengalaman ARDEX membantu pasukan latihan mereka bentuk peralihan realistik daripada operasi respons kepada perancangan pemulihan awal.
target_text: ARDEX experience helped the exercise team design realistic transitions from response operations to early recovery planning.

source_text: SME pengurusan maklumat mencadangkan sistem triage laporan yang mudah untuk tempoh bencana berjumlah laporan tinggi.
target_text: The SME on information management recommended a simple report triage system for high-volume disaster periods.

source_text: Perbincangan AAR menekankan keperluan untuk taklimat lebih pendek, pemilik tugas yang lebih jelas, dan penjejakan keputusan yang lebih baik.
target_text: AAR discussions highlighted the need for shorter briefings, clearer task owners, and better tracking of decisions.

source_text: GenAI menyokong triage terjemahan dengan mengenal pasti laporan yang memerlukan semakan manusia segera sebelum penyebaran.
target_text: GenAI supported translation triage by identifying reports that needed urgent human review before dissemination.

source_text: LLM merangka ringkasan laporan tempat perlindungan, tetapi pengurus maklumat membuang angka yang tidak pasti sebelum dikeluarkan.
target_text: The LLM drafted a summary of shelter reports, but the information manager removed uncertain numbers before release.

source_text: Data Sentinel-1 membantu perancang mengenal pasti segmen jalan yang banjir dan tersembunyi di bawah litupan awan dalam imejan optik.
target_text: Sentinel-1 data helped planners identify flooded road segments hidden beneath cloud cover in optical imagery.

source_text: Pemetaan Copernicus menyokong perbandingan laporan daerah rasmi dengan pemerhatian remote-sensing bebas.
target_text: Copernicus mapping supported the comparison of official district reports with independent remote-sensing observations.

source_text: Digital Twin menunjukkan bahawa memindahkan satu hab logistik lebih dekat ke pantai boleh memperbaik masa penghantaran.
target_text: The Digital Twin showed that moving one logistics hub closer to the coast could improve delivery timing.

source_text: Hybrid Exercise membolehkan perancang jarak jauh menguji keputusan dasar sementara pasukan lapangan berlatih penerimaan kargo.
target_text: The Hybrid Exercise allowed remote planners to test policy decisions while field teams practiced cargo reception.

source_text: Interoperability bertambah baik selepas pasukan maklumat menerbitkan panduan ringkas tentang nama tempat dan format data.
target_text: Interoperability improved after the information team published a short guide on place names and data formats.

source_text: Information Overload dikurangkan apabila setiap sel hanya menyerahkan keputusan yang diperlukan, perubahan besar, dan kekangan kritikal.
target_text: Information Overload was reduced when each cell submitted only decisions needed, major changes, and critical constraints.

source_text: ToR menjelaskan bahawa pegawai perhubungan harus berkongsi maklumat, bukan menugaskan aset secara bebas di luar saluran yang diluluskan.
target_text: The ToR clarified that liaison officers should share information, not independently task assets outside approved channels.

source_text: Pembangunan CONOPS merangkumi branch plans untuk penutupan pelabuhan, kesesakan lapangan terbang, lonjakan hospital, dan banjir baharu.
target_text: CONOPS development included branch plans for port closure, airfield congestion, hospital surge, and renewed flooding.

source_text: NFP memaklumkan rangkaian serantau bahawa dua tawaran yang diterima memerlukan masa ketibaan yang disemak semula.
target_text: The NFP informed the regional network that two accepted offers needed revised arrival times.

source_text: Sel perancangan menggunakan HADR untuk memutuskan sama ada kawasan industri yang rosak akibat banjir memerlukan nota keutamaan sektor yang seimbang.
target_text: The planning cell used HADR to decide whether the flood-damaged industrial estate needed a balanced sector priority note.

source_text: Papan pemuka Changi RHCC membantu menunjukkan keupayaan rakan kongsi mana yang boleh tiba dalam tempoh dua puluh empat jam seterusnya.
target_text: The Changi RHCC dashboard helped show which partner capabilities could arrive within the next twenty-four hours.

source_text: Sokongan pesawat US INDOPACOM dipertimbangkan hanya selepas pilihan jalan dan laut dinilai tidak mencukupi.
target_text: US INDOPACOM aircraft support was considered only after road and sea options were assessed as insufficient.

source_text: Pemerhati CFE-DM mencadangkan supaya sel koordinasi merekodkan sebab setiap pilihan operasi utama dibuat.
target_text: CFE-DM observers recommended that the coordination cell record why each major operational choice was made.

source_text: AHA Centre membantu menyelaraskan mesej sokongan serantau supaya rakan kongsi tidak menghantar maklumat bercanggah kepada affected state.
target_text: The AHA Centre helped align regional support messaging so partners did not send conflicting information to the affected state.

source_text: UN OCHA menyokong perbincangan keutamaan kemanusiaan yang memisahkan keperluan menyelamatkan nyawa segera daripada kebimbangan pemulihan awal.
target_text: UN OCHA supported a humanitarian priorities discussion that separated immediate life-saving needs from early recovery concerns.

source_text: Data penilaian ASEAN-ERAT membantu NDMO memperhalusi commune mana yang memerlukan pengesahan tambahan.
target_text: ASEAN-ERAT assessment data helped the NDMO refine which communes needed additional verification.

source_text: Fasilitator ACMC membantu peserta berlatih menerangkan pilihan sokongan ketenteraan kepada pembuat keputusan awam dalam bahasa mudah.
target_text: ACMC facilitators helped participants practice explaining military support options to civilian decision-makers in plain language.

source_text: Peta pendedahan PDC membantu mengutamakan mesej amaran untuk komuniti berhampiran sungai, cerun curam, dan jalan rosak.
target_text: PDC exposure maps helped prioritize warning messages for communities near rivers, steep slopes, and damaged roads.

source_text: WHO menasihati rakan kongsi kesihatan supaya memasukkan sokongan kesihatan mental dan psikososial dalam rancangan outreach tempat perlindungan.
target_text: WHO advised health partners to include mental health and psychosocial support in shelter outreach plans.

source_text: WFP merancang penghantaran makanan kontingensi untuk komuniti yang boleh terputus jika MSR ditutup semula.
target_text: WFP planned contingency food deliveries for communities that could be cut off if the MSR closed again.

source_text: ISCG meminta rakan kongsi mengemas kini anggaran penerima manfaat sebelum mencadangkan perluasan bantuan tempat perlindungan.
target_text: The ISCG asked partners to update beneficiary estimates before recommending an expansion of shelter assistance.

source_text: USAID BHA berkoordinasi dengan penderma lain untuk mengelakkan pembiayaan aktiviti bertindih di pusat pemindahan yang sama.
target_text: USAID BHA coordinated with other donors to avoid funding overlapping activities in the same evacuation centres.

source_text: Perbincangan ADMM-Plus menekankan interoperability praktikal antara angkatan pertahanan semasa respons bencana, bukan hanya dialog strategik.
target_text: ADMM-Plus discussions emphasized practical interoperability between defence forces during disaster response, not only strategic dialogue.

source_text: EWG on HADR mengenal pasti latihan perhubungan sebagai keperluan berulang merentasi beberapa latihan serantau.
target_text: The EWG on HADR identified liaison training as a recurring need across multiple regional exercises.

source_text: Koordinasi INSARAG membantu negara tuan rumah membahagikan kerja penyelamatan antara pasukan dengan keupayaan ringan, sederhana, dan berat.
target_text: INSARAG coordination helped the host nation divide rescue work between teams with light, medium, and heavy capabilities.

source_text: ASEAN Secretariat berkongsi ringkasan mesyuarat akhir dengan negara anggota dan pemerhati latihan.
target_text: The ASEAN Secretariat shared the final meeting summary with member states and exercise observers.

source_text: Ahli AMRG on HADR membandingkan seberapa cepat force package berbeza boleh dikerahkan selepas permintaan rasmi.
target_text: AMRG on HADR members compared how quickly different force packages could deploy after official request.

source_text: Personel SAF memberi nasihat tentang aliran kargo yang selamat apabila forklift, bas, pasukan perubatan, dan pesawat berkongsi ruang apron terhad.
target_text: SAF personnel advised on safe cargo flow when forklifts, buses, medical teams, and aircraft shared limited apron space.

source_text: Sokongan PLA diselaraskan melalui MNCC supaya tugas kejuruteraan kekal sejajar dengan keutamaan nasional.
target_text: PLA support was coordinated through the MNCC so engineering tasks remained aligned with national priorities.

source_text: JOCCA mengekalkan matriks bantuan serantau yang menunjukkan tawaran, status penugasan, dan jurang koordinasi yang masih ada.
target_text: JOCCA maintained a regional assistance matrix that showed offers, tasking status, and remaining coordination gaps.

source_text: Pemimpin penyelamat SCDF menekankan kepentingan pengurusan keletihan semasa operasi pencarian yang berpanjangan.
target_text: SCDF rescue leaders stressed the importance of fatigue management during extended search operations.

source_text: VINASARCOM mengesahkan bahawa pihak berkuasa wilayah harus melaporkan keperluan melalui saluran nasional dan bukannya meminta pasukan asing secara langsung.
target_text: VINASARCOM confirmed that provincial authorities should report needs through national channels rather than directly requesting foreign teams.

source_text: Pemantauan sungai VDDMA menunjukkan bahawa puncak banjir akan sampai ke daerah hilir lebih lewat daripada jangkaan asal.
target_text: VDDMA river monitoring showed that flood peaks would reach downstream districts later than originally expected.

source_text: Sokongan VPA membantu membuka semula segmen jalan yang menghubungkan dua pusat pemindahan dengan hospital terdekat.
target_text: VPA support helped reopen a road segment that connected two evacuation centres with the nearest hospital.

source_text: MARD menasihati bahawa perancangan bantuan harus mengambil kira petani yang kehilangan alat, benih, dan makanan ternakan.
target_text: MARD advised that relief planning should account for farmers who lost tools, seed, and livestock feed.

source_text: Kemas kini jambatan MOT membolehkan perancang konvoi mengalihkan kargo berat ke laluan yang lebih selamat.
target_text: MOT bridge updates allowed convoy planners to shift heavy cargo onto safer routes.

source_text: MOH berkoordinasi dengan VAMS untuk membandingkan laporan kapasiti hospital dengan data pemindahan ambulans.
target_text: MOH coordinated with VAMS to compare hospital capacity reports with ambulance transfer data.

source_text: Rakan kongsi DRRP mencadangkan pengukuhan jawatankuasa bencana komuniti berdasarkan jurang yang didedahkan oleh senario.
target_text: DRRP partners recommended strengthening community disaster committees based on gaps revealed by the scenario.

source_text: Pembiayaan QPT membantu menyelenggara peralatan pemindahan tempatan yang digunakan sebelum bantuan luar tiba.
target_text: QPT funding helped maintain local evacuation equipment that was used before outside assistance arrived.

source_text: Sukarelawan VNRC mengenal pasti isi rumah yang memerlukan dokumen gantian, sokongan pencarian keluarga, dan barangan bantuan asas.
target_text: VNRC volunteers identified households needing replacement documents, family tracing support, and basic relief items.

source_text: VAMS berkongsi ringkasan lonjakan hospital sebelum mesyuarat koordinasi akhir latihan.
target_text: VAMS shared a hospital surge summary before the final coordination meeting of the exercise.

source_text: Koordinasi WoG membantu pemimpin menghubungkan keputusan kecemasan dengan perancangan pemulihan untuk pengangkutan, pertanian, dan kesihatan awam.
target_text: WoG coordination helped leaders connect emergency decisions with recovery planning for transport, agriculture, and public health.

source_text: NDMO menutup permintaan tertunda terakhir selepas mengesahkan bahawa pihak berkuasa wilayah tidak lagi memerlukan sokongan luar tambahan.
target_text: The NDMO closed the last pending request after confirming that provincial authorities no longer required additional external support.

source_text: Staf CMCoord mendokumentasikan pengajaran tentang cara meminta keupayaan ketenteraan tanpa mengganggu sistem koordinasi kemanusiaan.
target_text: CMCoord staff documented lessons on how to request military capabilities without disrupting humanitarian coordination systems.

source_text: NFP mengemas kini rakan kongsi bahawa affected state telah menerima sokongan rawatan air tetapi menolak pasukan penyelamat tambahan.
target_text: The NFP updated partners that the affected state had accepted water treatment support but declined additional rescue teams.

source_text: Semakan ringkas tentang Capacity Building [Efforts to strengthen stakeholder response ability] membantu operator radio mentafsir lonjakan hujan waktu malam tanpa melambatkan senarai keutamaan yang dibetulkan.
target_text: A short review of Capacity Building [Efforts to strengthen stakeholder response ability] helped radio operators interpret a night-time rainfall surge without delaying a corrected priority list.
